case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

## Recommendation
- **Go to South Haven for the pier.** My rating: 2 of 4 (average). It's the only pier with a recent average rating, and it is still the best of the four.
- **Grand Haven is second (1 of 4).** Its last pier report was slow.
- **Muskegon and St. Joseph are 0 of 4 (slow).** Their last pier reports were slow, so I'd skip them for pier fishing this week.
- **At South Haven, cast spoons and spinners.** Pier anglers there caught fish on those. Pier fish depth and water depth were not reported.
- **Check the pier before you go.** Expect the bite to fade during the week, as it did last report.

## Why
- South Haven's pier was the only one rated average in the newest reports, and it was good early in that week before slowing (South Haven, 2024-08-28).
- Grand Haven's pier was slow last report, and the same week's boats did better than the pier (Grand Haven, 2024-08-28).
- Muskegon and St. Joseph had no pier report on Aug 28, and their last pier reports on Aug 21 were slow (Muskegon and St. Joseph, 2024-08-21).
- I'd expect the cold water pushed in by this week's north-to-east winds to help the piers a little, but I have no pier report since that wind, so this is a guess.

## Evidence
**Recent reports** (newest is 2024-08-28, six days old)
- South Haven, 2024-08-28, pier: rated 2. "Pier fishing was good for salmon and steelhead early in the week, but died down as the week went on."
- South Haven, 2024-08-21, pier: rated 1. "Pier anglers caught a few salmon from the piers, along with a few steelhead... casting spoons and spinners."
- Grand Haven, 2024-08-28, pier: rated 0. "Pier action for salmon slowed down."
- Grand Haven, 2024-08-21, pier: not rated. "Pier anglers caught salmon on alewives and while casting glow spoons."
- Muskegon, 2024-08-21, pier: rated 0. "Pier anglers casting for salmon found the action to be slow." No pier entry on Aug 28.
- St. Joseph, 2024-08-21, pier: rated 0. "Pier fishing was very slow for steelhead and salmon." No pier entry on Aug 28.
- Boats did better than the piers at most ports. Grand Haven and South Haven boats were rated good on Aug 28, and Muskegon boats were slow (Aug 28, all ports).

**Past seasons** (history, not current)
- Late August and September pier reports were usually slow or average. Pier action was rated 0 at most ports in 2022 and 2023 (Grand Haven 2022-09-14 and 2022-09-21; Muskegon 2022-09-07; St. Joseph 2023-08-30).
- Pier reports were rated average only in some years, and then mostly for early-week catches.

**Conditions now** (the tool returned a summary of the week before Sept 3, not live data)
- Buoy surface water: St. Joseph 74 F, South Haven 72 F, Grand Haven 71 F, Muskegon 71 F (summary for the week before 2024-09-03).
- Satellite water near the piers fell 2–3 F in the last 3 days at all four ports, with a 2 F drop at Grand Haven and Muskegon and a 3 F drop at South Haven and St. Joseph (satellite, same summary).
- Upwelling wind (north to east, 8+ mph) totaled 15–22 hours in the last 3 days, with the most at St. Joseph (22 h) and South Haven (21 h) (same summary).

## Caveats
- The newest reports are six days old, and the pier ratings for Muskegon and St. Joseph are from Aug 21 (13 days old).
- The current-conditions tool returned a backtest summary, not live readings, so the water and wind figures are for the week before Sept 3.
- The satellite values are from the GLSEA satellite, not measured at the pier, and can lag a day or two.
- The reference guidance says mature Chinook in early fall hold near 55 F or less. Buoy readings of 71–74 F are well above that, so I'd expect the fish to be deeper offshore, not at the pier. This is general guidance, not a report finding.

## Sources
- Aug 28, 2024 DNR weekly report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3b19036
- Aug 21, 2024 DNR weekly report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3b02c05
